told_after: I could not read 500 problems alone when I met them; now I can read 2 of them alone (2 with my own reader).

Where I am weak: stories I do not know how to put together yet (313 problems), questions asked in a way I do not know yet (66 problems), telling who a "he", "she" or "they" is (35 problems), numbers in a story that I do not know how to use (35 problems), stories in which an amount seemed not to be given (28 problems), comparisons and differences whose two sides I could not tell (12 problems), stories my reading got wrong (solving or checking it showed that) (9 problems).

What I want to learn: stories I do not know how to put together yet (for example: "A company was offering a special on cell phones for $2 each. But only if you spent 7 dollars a month for 4 months. How much would it end up costing you total if you bought 1 phone?"); questions asked in a way I do not know yet (for example: "A piece of plywood was cut so its length was 6 feet by 5 feet. What is the perimeter of the wood?"); telling who a "he", "she" or "they" is (for example: "Upon arriving at the school, Buddy immediately went to his teacher where he was introduced to all the third grade students in the school. There were 57 girl students and 66 boy students. How many third graders did Buddy meet in the school?").
